items.q: How much does hot tub removal cost in Port Perry?
a: Pricing is confirmed on site once the crew sees the tub’s size, condition and how hard it is to get to — with no scenic-town or waterfront premium anywhere in the township. A portable spa costs less than a full six-seater with tight dock access, and the number covers draining, cutting, hauling and disposal together.

items.q: Is there really no charge for waterfront or island properties?
a: Never. The same flat pricing applies at a Queen Street backyard and at the end of a Scugog Island lane — no distance fee, no access charge, no seasonal surcharge.

items.q: Do I need to drain the hot tub myself before you arrive?
a: No — draining is part of the service. The Live Junk Free crew handles it safely on arrival, and you don’t need a hose, a pump, or any prep beyond making sure the area around the tub is reasonably accessible.

items.q: Is it safe to remove a hot tub that's still wired to electrical?
a: Only once the power is confirmed off. If your tub has a hardwired 240V connection, we ask that a licensed electrician disconnect it before the crew arrives — we don’t disconnect live electrical ourselves, for your safety and ours.

items.q: Can you remove a hot tub on Scugog Island or a waterfront cottage?
a: Regularly, and gently. Dock access, shoreline decking and seasonal scheduling all get planned at the walkthrough, with the same flat pricing as any other Port Perry property.
